description: This file defines the FooTable.Rows class, which manages row handling, parsing, rendering, and interactions within a FooTable instance. It includes methods for parsing rows from DOM or options, drawing rows, loading data, and expanding/collapsing rows.

classes.name: FooTable.Rows
classes.description: Class managing the collection of rows in a FooTable, including parsing, rendering, and interaction logic.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Rows class with the parent table, setting up options and internal state.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses rows from DOM or options, returning a promise that resolves with an array of Row objects.

methods.name: parseFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes parsing by converting raw data into Row objects and resolving the deferred.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Pre-initialization method to parse and check column options, and set up internal state before initialization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Rows component after parsing, triggering UI creation.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the Rows component, removing UI and resetting internal state.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Prepares rows for drawing by creating shallow clones.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the empty row placeholder element.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the rows into the table body, handling empty state if no rows are present.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads new row data into the table, optionally appending or replacing existing rows.
